messages:
Ravi: Quick sync — partner SI wants a small refkit example that shows network allowlist, manifest.json sample, and a minimal smoke harness. Can infra + enablement review?
Maya: Sounds good. Keep it single-file copy-pasteable for SIs. Key asks: 1) explicit egress/CIDR notes, 2) sample manifest snippet for Verified Models, 3) a tiny terraform module usage + expected outputs, 4) smoke test commands with pass criteria.
Ellen: I'll draft the manifest and smoke commands. For pass criteria: HTTP 200, model returns non-empty "output" and latency < 1s p50 for the smoke prompt.
Chao: Infra: I'll add the network and IAM caveats. Important: partners often forget to allow the control-plane egress IPs and the registry host for image pulls. We'll include an allowlist block.
Ravi: Example allowlist note (short): "Allow outbound to registry.redwood.ai:443 and controlplane-ips: 18.205.0.0/16, 3.210.0.0/16". Keep it non-exhaustive with link to full list.
Ellen: Draft manifest snippet (to include in doc):
```
{
  "model_name": "partner/small-chat-1",
  "version": "v2026-03-10",
  "container": "ghcr.io/partner/small-chat:2026-03-10",
  "sha256": "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924",
  "verified": true
}
```
Chao: Terraform module usage (module source + inputs only) example to paste into quickstart:
```
module "refkit_partner" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refkit-terraform.git//modules/partner?ref=v0.2.0"
  region = "us-west-2"
  refkit_vpc_id = "vpc-0abc1234"
  kms_key_arn = "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd1234"
}
output "endpoint" {
  value = module.refkit_partner.endpoint
}
```
Maya: Nice. Also include a tiny smoke harness that SIs can run from their CI (bash):
```
set -e
ENDPOINT=$(terraform output -raw endpoint)
resp=$(curl -s -X POST "${ENDPOINT}/v1/generate" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"ping","max_tokens":8}')
if [[ "$resp" == *"output" ]]; then
  echo "smoke PASS"
  exit 0
else
  echo "smoke FAIL: no output" >&2
  echo $resp >&2
  exit 2
fi
```
Ellen: I'll add pass criteria to checklist: must return 200, non-empty output, and p50 < 1s on the smoke prompt when run from partner CI in same region. If CI is cross-region, note that latency will vary.
Chao: Security note: recommend partners create a dedicated KMS key with key policy granting only required roles; rotate yearly. Also include minimal IAM snippet for role that can call inference: `Action: ["inference:Invoke"] Resource: ["arn:aws:redwood:*/model/*"]`.
marketplace-bot: Packaging window reminder: final artifacts due 2026-04-20 23:59 UTC. Submit container + manifest at least 48h before.
Ravi: Timeline: Ellen will PR manifest + smoke section by Wednesday, Chao will add network/IAM notes today, Maya will assemble packaging checklist and upload internal review link on Thursday. Any blockers?
Maya: One ask  add an explicit line about immutable image tags in manifest and recommend digest pinning (sha256) when possible.
Ellen: Added digest line to the manifest snippet.
Chao: I'll also add the small firewall allowlist example text and a link to the canonical control-plane IP list in the doc.
Ravi: Great. If PRs land by Wed EOD we can hit marketplace window. Thanks all :rocket:
